name: Fenwick binary indexed tree prefix sums
definition: For 1≤i≤n, T_i=Σ_{j=i−lowbit(i)+1}^i x_j; prefix query accumulates T_i while i>0, replacing i by i−lowbit(i); point increment adds δ along i←i+lowbit(i).
variables: n array size; i one-based index; lowbit(i) least significant set bit; T_i partial sum; δ increment
assumptions: Fixed indexed numeric array and additive arithmetic; review pending
